name: Irving Energy (U.S. home heating)
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public irvingoil.com en-US pages (Home Energy FAQ, Price Protection Plan, Log In) and the public myaccount.irvingenergy.com 'Login or Register' page; no sign-in, no registration, no forms submitted. Residential customers use 'Irving Energy - My Account' (commercial: My Business Account). Sign-in: Email Address + Password. Existing customers who have never logged in register under 'Already a customer, but haven't logged in?' with Account Number (digits before the dash only), Phone Number (10 digits) and Email Address; a temporary password is emailed. In My Account customers view statements and invoices, pay invoices and set up automatic payments; payment options are online, automatic bank transfer (EFT) and credit card per delivery or as automatic card deduction; payments can also be arranged by phone at 1.888.310.1924 (Mon-Fri 7-7, Sat 8-2). Emailed invoices/statements are requested by phone or the online contact form (paperless is therefore modelled as not self-service online). Equalized Payment plan spreads the estimated season cost into equal monthly payments; Cap Price (fee, amount not published) and Fixed Price plans need a Fuel Agreement; automatic-delivery customers can enroll in price protection in My Account. $95 emergency delivery fee for non-automatic customers is a delivery charge, not a payment fee. Late charges and closing an account are not published on the pages used.

Price Protection Plan for Home Heating | Irving Oil

autopay.note: Automatic payments can come from your bank account (EFT) or be charged to your credit card.

paperless.note: Your statements and invoices are always available in My Account. To have them emailed to you instead, call us at 1.888.310.1924 or contact us online.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Pay online in Irving Energy My Account, set up automatic payments from your bank account (EFT), or pay by credit card for each delivery or with an automatic card deduction.
You can also arrange a payment with our energy experts at 1.888.310.1924, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. and Saturday 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.
steps: Go to Login and choose Irving Energy - My Account.
Sign in with your email address and password.
Open your invoices and choose the one to pay.

help.title: First time in My Account
paragraphs: Already a customer but never logged in? On the Register tab enter your account number (only the digits before the dash), the 10-digit phone number on your account and your email address. A temporary password is emailed to you.
My Account is for residential customers; commercial customers use My Business Account.

help.title: Emailed statements
paragraphs: Your statements and invoices are always available in My Account. To receive them by email instead of on paper, call 1.888.310.1924 or use the online contact form.

help.title: Equalized payments and price protection
paragraphs: With the Equalized Payment plan, Irving Energy estimates your fuel cost for the heating season and divides it into equal monthly payments, so your budget is predictable.

The Price Protection Program, for propane and heating oil customers in Maine, New Hampshire and Vermont, offers a Cap Price (capped for 12 months, with a fee) or a Fixed Price. Both require a signed Fuel Agreement; automatic-delivery customers can sign up in My Account. Call 1.888.310.1924 with questions.

extra.intent: Using the Irving Energy website's help pages, find the phone number to call to arrange a payment. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
